## Claims
- [computed] Task-owned artifact `c523b9a65c6908594380392aa237d0d15e3a53c7154d8f26dc0882ce1754659d` (script SHA-256 `b7689eefc9b68455d47d84900619899ea47b0fc296b66414696f4c9167b08df0`) executed self-contained Python partition/horizontal-strip enumeration with exit status \(0\). Inputs were \(i,j=2,\ldots,6\), \(p,c=1,\ldots,5\), \(\min(p,c)=1\); captured output reports 225 parameter tuples, 900 checks of \(h_1x_0=x_1+y_1\), \(h_2x_0=\gamma+z+y_2\), \(h_1x_1=\gamma+x_2+z\), \(h_1y_1=z+y_2+\theta\), and 25 doubly-boundary checks. It reports matrix \([[0,1,1],[1,1,0],[0,1,1]]\) on \([x_2,z,y_2]\), minor \([[1,1],[1,0]]\) on one-based rows \([1,2]\), columns \([z,y_2]\), determinant \(-1\), and `RESULT: PASS`. [artifact c523b9a65c6908594380392aa237d0d15e3a53c7154d8f26dc0882ce1754659d]
- [computed] Failed task-owned execution `cba25213fffc4bb931dfb264ddbc95dd73da45bc758cf5434d03adc6b383688f` had exit status \(1\), caused by selecting rows \([2,3]\) rather than the stated rows \([1,2]\) for the minor; it supplies no positive result. [artifact cba25213fffc4bb931dfb264ddbc95dd73da45bc758cf5434d03adc6b383688f]

## Strategy
The successful artifact contains executable code, explicit finite inputs, captured stdout/stderr, exit status, and stable digest. It independently enumerates partitions and horizontal strips rather than hard-coding Pieri outputs.

The requested finite computation capability certificate is established.

## Gaps
The successful computation is finite and does not prove the identities outside its stated input range or establish any parent theorem.
